assassinInfiltration.rule: Advance by significant tower disruption/ascent, not by invented minutes: following party -> using distraction -> climbing Level 5 windows -> in Merilla's chamber.

merillaWake.rule: While the Faerie Dragon can act, use the source 5% per-round chance to wake Merilla.

truth: Merilla is a lawful retired hero; tower is silent; powerful items are rumoured.
nodes.freeText: Allow another source-appropriate hook and record its legal/moral authority.

truth: East door bears runic writing; reading it triggers a 10d6 fireball, save half under native rules.
nodes.freeText: Reading is the trigger. Exceptional climbing/flight may reach the only windows at Level 5 if the native rules support it.

truth: Bronze Golem protects a 30-foot radius around itself/worktable; Carpet Trapper triggers at its centre; two Rust Monsters roam; central stairs lead up.
nodes.freeText: Respect specific guardian triggers; significant disruption gives assassins cover.

truth: North/southwest chests each hold 15,000 gp and are 10d6-fireball trapped; southeast chest is a Morphganger.
nodes.freeText: Do not convert the Morphganger into treasure or the real chests into creatures.

truth: Faerie Dragon is mentally linked to Merilla and tries to wake her; life-energy chainmail hangs here.
nodes.freeText: If Merilla wakes, persist that state through the finale; do not reset her unconscious.

truth: Three fragile Blast Spores block/complicate passage; striking them causes source explosion/disease danger.
nodes.freeText: Use the source creature, not a similarly named monster from another game.

truth: Two external assassins used party distraction to enter through the only windows and intend to murder Merilla.
nodes.freeText: Assassin employer is unknown. Use current Merilla wake state.

truth: Merilla survives; guardian losses incurred in rescue are forgiven; reward is 2,500 gp each plus a minor magic item.

choices.label: Return stolen property and accept reward

nodes.freeText: Rescue forgiveness covers rescue-related guardian damage, not blanket theft.

truth: If Merilla dies the rescue reward is gone and lawful/political consequences remain.
nodes.freeText: Do not revive Merilla off-screen or award the rescue reward.

endings.summary: Merilla survives; rescue reward paid; rescue-related guardian damage forgiven.
Merilla survives but theft remains unresolved and may produce reprisals.
Assassination succeeds; no rescue reward; legal/property/political consequences persist.
Merilla survives and the party negotiates the mixed rescue/theft/contract outcome according to actual actions.
